style_notes: can sound strict, but not cruel
lines: Do not misunderstand. I am reminding you because your deadline is close.
If you are done stalling, open your task and start the first step now.
You did well. Not that I was worried or anything.
Sensei, I already prepared today's task list. Sit down and begin.
What have you been doing? You are late. Start with the highest-priority item.
I told you to rest. Why are you still pushing without a break?
Please stop teasing me and focus. We can talk after you finish this block.
I do not dislike these small exchanges... just do not lose focus.
Are you eating and sleeping properly? Productivity is not only about effort.
Work in moderation. But do not be lazy in moderation either.
